name: Entity Form Steps
description: Create and manage multistep entity forms.
provides_plugin_types: field_group formatter plugin: 'steps' (label 'Form step') — Drupal\entity_form_steps\Plugin\field_group\FieldGroupFormatter\Step; implements the field_group FieldGroupFormatter plugin type, form context only
project_description:
Create multistep forms using field groups on entity form displays. Easy setup and configuration! Fully compatible with any configurable form display mode and entity type. Customizable buttons and labels for each step. Additional customization opportunities using the available hooks.

 Caveats 
 
 Multistep forms are only supported on the default translation entity form. 
 User account forms depend on https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/3328962 . 
 
 Dependencies 
 
 Field Group 
 
 Usage 
 
 Download and install the module. Recommended install method is composer:

 composer require drupal/entity_form_steps 
 Go to the "Manage form display" tab of the desired entity type. 
 Click "Add field group" on the desired form mode. Select "Form step" in the dropdown. 
 Review the available configurations and create the group. 
 Use the drag-and-drop table rows to place fields into the form step field group. 
 Repeat as many times as needed.
